prompt:
Refactor this JavaScript promise chain into clean async/await with proper error handling, retry logic, and timeout. Explain differences in error propagation:
```javascript
function fetchUserData(userId) {
  return fetch(`/api/users/${userId}`)
    .then(r => r.json())
    .then(user => fetch(`/api/users/${userId}/preferences`)
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(prefs => fetch(`/api/users/${userId}/notifications`)
        .then(r => r.json())
        .then(notifs => ({...user, prefs, notifs}))))
    .catch(e => console.log(e))
}
```
label: strong
reasoning: Requires complex code refactoring, implementation of advanced logic (retry, timeout), and technical explanation.
